name: LAMOST (Guo Shoujing Telescope) at Xinglong Observatory
description: The Large Sky Area Multi-Object Fiber Spectroscopic Telescope, also called the Guo Shoujing Telescope, at Xinglong Station. About 4000 optical fibers on its focal surface let it take thousands of spectra per night.
highlights: It was planned to survey the spectra of 10 million Milky Way stars plus millions of galaxies.
Its data releases began in June 2013, and the official site lists a public DR11 release.
It runs two surveys: LEGAS (extragalactic) and LEGUE (Galactic).
